ANSWER: YES

HALLUCINATIONS:
- Claim that the extensions are “only 5-6 days.” The amendment extends at least one deadline from November 30, 2021 to 11:59 P.M. on December 7, 2021 (a 7-day extension), so this duration statement is not supported by the source document.

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo treats the same fact (short deadline extensions) as both a positive (\u201cminor extensions...suggest temporary operational delays rather than fundamental credit issues\u201d) and a negative (\u201cPIK Interest payment extension suggests possible near-term liquidity constraints\u201d), which are incompatible assessments of the same item.", "It claims \u201cAll existing loan documentation and covenant structure remains intact and enforceable\u201d while also describing an amendment that changes key date obligations (PIK interest, ABL consent, warrant issuance), meaning the original terms did not remain fully intact."]}
